verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has a well-documented native tmux control mode (tmux -CC) that integrates tmux sessions natively into iTerm2's window/pane UI while preserving persistence across SSH disconnects and app restarts, plus standard tmux-in-terminal usage is naturally supported. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of tmux -CC mode (community evidence covers other features, not tmux integration directly).
